# Liquid Glass Web v0.1.0

First public preview of the standalone, Codex-first `liquid-glass-web` Agent
Skill.

## Included

- Pinned canonical Liquid Glass CSS and SVG/JavaScript refraction snippet.
- Agent Skills structure plus Codex UI metadata in `agents/openai.yaml`.
- English and Chinese documentation.
- Four offline, single-file examples: Quick Start, Component Gallery, Music
  Player, and Résumé / Portfolio.
- GitHub Pages demo generated from canonical sources.
- Structural, hash, HTML, browser, console, motion, theme, frost-retention, and
  axe accessibility checks.

## Compatibility note

- Chromium receives SVG displacement refraction when the conservative runtime
  gate passes.
- Safari and WebKit use the frosted fallback while WebKit bug 245510 remains
  unresolved.
- Playwright Firefox passed the automated release suite. A real Firefox
  application has not been manually accepted for `v0.1.0`; that check is
  intentionally deferred.

This release contains the Git tag and GitHub's automatic source archives only.
No `.skill`, npm, CDN, or Plugin artifact is attached.
